verdict.rationale: Instinct's own privacy policy refers to an official Mac OS application, and its homepage says it connects to your 'screen', so a first-party desktop app with screen access is documented. Nothing in the pack mentions OS-level keyboard shortcuts or hotkeys, and the screen access is a single marketing line with no hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: documented OS-level shortcuts/hotkeys, detailed docs on screen-access behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Mac app and screen features.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can use an official desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and access to what is on my screen

citations.quote: Instinct's autonomous personal assistant, the related Mac OS and mobile applications (the "App")
It connects to your applications and devices - email, messaging, screen, audio, location, and more.
